I stand behind my statements. You clearly know little about the infosec world. I have worked in IT and in that space for over 20 years and I know a bit. These hacking exhibitions make the products stronger. They increase the reputation of the security experts that discover or develop the exploits. You might not be impressed by public hacking but those in the infosec world are. Designing novel and creative attack vectors in a public forum is what turns unknown white hats into well paid security experts.
